entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent candidate tower sprite for the supplied game. Input image 1 is the STRICT final sculpted 3D-look material, camera, lighting and clarity target; input image 2 supplies ONLY the existing stone tower identity and structure, not its pixelated texture. Recreate ONLY the level 1 STONE TOWER in row 2 column 1 of image 2, now in the exact high-quality smooth rounded prerender appearance of image 1. Short squat circular masonry turret of chunky pale warm grey bevelled stones, a modest arched dark opening in its front, 2 broad courses of stone forming a ring with an open top. A clearly identifiable wooden Y-shaped sling catapult is mounted in the top: two warm honey-brown thick wood posts leaning slightly apart, cream rope binding around the tips, tension rope and a dark brown leather sling pouch holding one round grey stone. Entire apparatus is compact and physically connected; no floating rope or unsupported weapon. Orthographic three-quarter elevated camera, 25 degrees down, same direction as the first arrow tower in image 1. Low stout proportions, same game scale. Rich but restrained soft 3D materials: rounded stone with broad gentle variation, carved wood with subtle grain, soft upper-left warm key light, ambient occlusion in masonry seams. No thick black outline, no pixel art, no painterly poster grain, no hyperreal texture. A little grass nestled just at the foundation seams, no large attached dirt platform. No banner, no extra upgrade ornaments. One complete tower, centered on a true transparent background, about 84 percent canvas height; full foundation and weapon visible. No ground cast shadow, no text, no UI, no borders, no other objects. Clean opaque surfaces and crisp anti-aliased transparent edge, no semi-transparent haze around the object. This is a still design sample, not a parts sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent candidate frost tower sprite for the supplied game. Image 1 is the STRICT final smooth sculpted 3D-look material, clarity, lighting and camera target. Image 2 supplies ONLY the existing level 1 FROST TOWER identity, row 3 column 1, not its pixelated art technique. Recreate just that small first-tier frost tower in the exact polished friendly dimensional quality of image 1. Small stout circular wooden pavilion, thick warm honey-brown rounded timber posts, low rounded grey stone foundation ring, golden ochre curved overlapping roof tiles with gently flared eaves. One small faceted cyan ice crystal mounted centrally on the roof in a restrained warm brass socket; crystal is solid, softly translucent-looking but clear opaque form, no glow cloud, no magic particles. Under the roof a small shaded open gap and wooden rail. A small cyan diamond in a simple golden mount on the front. Two short cream fabric hanging strips on narrow side beams, minimal detail. Retain level 1 proportions and simplicity: one roof, one crystal, no extra floors, no gold crown, no double eaves. Orthographic elevated three-quarter camera 25 degrees down, same as the arrow tower in image 1. Soft warm upper-left key light, gentle reflected fill and ambient occlusion in the roof recess; smooth sculpted toy-like wood, tile, stone and crystal, subtly varied material surfaces, rounded contours, no sharp black outlines, no realistic noisy grain, no pixel art or painterly poster texture. One complete object centered at 84 percent of canvas height on genuine transparent background. Tiny sparse grass at the stones only, no attached big dirt platform. No external cast shadow, no backdrop, no labels or text, no UI, no borders, no other objects, no detached parts. Clean opaque surfaces and anti-aliased alpha edge. This is a still design sample.
